questions.topic: Page 5: 1.3 THE 2-D CARTESIAN COORDINATE SYSTEM (Pages 5-6 Focus)
questions.questionText: The plane in which the coordinate axes are situated is called the ______.
questions.explanationAnswer: The text explicitly defines the plane containing the axes as the Cartesian plane, coordinate plane, or xy-plane.
questions.explanationQuestion: The question asks for the terminology used to describe the 2-D space defined by two perpendicular axes.

questions.topic: Page 5: 1.3 THE 2-D CARTESIAN COORDINATE SYSTEM (Pages 5-6 Focus)
questions.questionText: Which of the following statements correctly describe the sign conventions for quadrants in the Cartesian plane?

options.optionText: Quadrant I: both x- and y-coordinates positive
Quadrant II: negative x-coordinate and positive y-coordinate
Quadrant III: both x- and y-coordinates positive
Quadrant IV: positive x-coordinate and negative y-coordinate

multi: Quadrant I: both x- and y-coordinates positive
Quadrant II: negative x-coordinate and positive y-coordinate
Quadrant IV: positive x-coordinate and negative y-coordinate
questions.explanationAnswer: Quadrant I is (+, +), Quadrant II is (-, +), Quadrant III is (-, -), and Quadrant IV is (+, -). Option 3 is incorrect because Quadrant III has both negative.
questions.explanationQuestion: The question tests the understanding of coordinate signs in different quadrants.

questions.topic: Page 5: 1.3 THE 2-D CARTESIAN COORDINATE SYSTEM (Pages 5-6 Focus)
questions.questionText: In the coordinate pair $(x, y)$, $x$ represents the perpendicular distance from the ______ and $y$ represents the perpendicular distance from the ______.
questions.explanationAnswer: The x-coordinate is the distance measured along the x-axis from the y-axis, and the y-coordinate is the distance measured along the y-axis from the x-axis.
questions.explanationQuestion: The question tests the definition of coordinates as distances from the axes.
